fields.value: A tall, heavy-looking young man with formal manners.
Pompous, ceremonious, self-important, obsequious toward rank, and insensitive to other people’s responses.
To display respectability, please Lady Catherine, secure a wife, and perform generosity toward the Bennet family.
Mr Bennet’s distant cousin and heir under the Longbourn entail; recently established as a clergyman through Lady Catherine’s patronage.
Clergyman and rector of Hunsford parish.
Comic embodiment of social deference, entail pressure, and marriage without emotional understanding.
Distant cousin and legal heir of Mr Bennet; husband of Charlotte Lucas.
Transfers his proposal from Elizabeth to Charlotte and remains essentially unchanged, though Charlotte organizes a workable household around him.
Charlotte: wife and practical manager. Lady Catherine: patroness and model of authority. Bennets: cousins whose estate he will inherit.
